turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
This morning. The zero was entered on November 3. Was Owen heard before that, yes or no?
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
His bedtime isn't on the table. I'll take your silence as a no. What do you have?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
A genuinely thoughtful kid, and you gave him a zero. Show me why.
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
It became one when he read his mark off his phone in class. Put something on this desk, Hale.
